# NJ Talingting

Hello, world! I'm currently working as a Statistics intern at the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) and a maintainer of several spatial R packages published on the Comprehensive R Archive Network (CRAN).

My years in public office and studies of statistics near the Cebu Port Authority has deeply grounded my work so that they meet the **reality of archipelagic life**.

Outside work, I've founded [PinasR](https://pinasr.r-universe.dev/packages), a centralized repository for R packages made by Filipinos. You may find my core spatial tools at [CRAN](https://r-project.org).
